semiconductor_relevance: High — Inspec specializes in inspection and measurement equipment critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Inspec develops advanced inspection equipment designed for high-speed and high-precision inspection of semiconductor materials, including PCBs and ceramic substrates. Their latest model supports next-generation fine pattern inspections and incorporates AI for enhanced verification efficiency.
capabilities: Pattern inspection for fine features down to L/S: 1.5/1.5μm
Visual inspection of PCBs, ceramic substrates, and CCLs
Integrated unwinding/rewinding unit for compact design
